# Trigger.dev v4.6.3

> Documentation generated from the latest stable release of [triggerdotdev/trigger.dev](https://github.com/triggerdotdev/trigger.dev) and pinned to immutable source commit `2d03fee2e3ff368128302ed4c783ba4e32d1cb00`.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt): Complete normalized corpus for Trigger.dev v4.6.3.
- [Provenance manifest](manifest.json): Release, commit, document count, and generation notes.
- Pages follow the navigation declared in docs/docs.json at the immutable release tag; snippets are inlined into the pages that import them rather than published separately.
- API reference pages are rendered from the OpenAPI specification the page names in its `openapi` frontmatter, since the upstream page carries no prose of its own.
- Static MDX cards, tabs, accordions, steps, callouts, and parameter fields are normalized to Markdown without executing JavaScript.
- Published page links resolve to https://trigger.dev/docs; source assets point at the immutable release commit.
- Quarantined sources (1): upstream pages using constructs this generator cannot convert yet are omitted and listed in `manifest.json`.

## Agents

- [AI Agents](pages/ai-chat/overview.md): Durable multi-turn AI chats — one Trigger.dev task per conversation, surviving refreshes, deploys, and crashes. (4875 bytes)
- [Quick Start](pages/ai-chat/quick-start.md): Get a working AI agent in 3 steps — define an agent, generate a token, and wire up the frontend. (6641 bytes)
- [Migrate from an AI SDK route handler](pages/ai-chat/migrating-from-a-route-handler.md): Move an existing useChat + streamText chat app to chat.agent — what stays identical, what you delete, and a prompt you can hand to a coding agent. (33833 bytes)
- [Anatomy of an agent](pages/ai-chat/anatomy.md): The three parts of a chat agent — the agent task that runs the turn loop, the durable session that carries messages, and the frontend transport — what each does and where it's documented. (4793 bytes)
- [Backend](pages/ai-chat/backend.md): Three approaches to building your chat backend — chat.agent(), session iterator, or raw task primitives. (43034 bytes)
- [Lifecycle hooks](pages/ai-chat/lifecycle-hooks.md): Hook into every stage of a chat agent's run: preload, turn start, turn complete, suspend, resume, and more. (42401 bytes)
- [Tools](pages/ai-chat/tools.md): Declare tools on chat.agent so toModelOutput survives across turns, get them back typed in run(), and type your messages from them. (10766 bytes)
- [Frontend](pages/ai-chat/frontend.md): Transport setup, session management, client data, and frontend patterns for AI Chat. (29186 bytes)
- [Server-Side Chat](pages/ai-chat/server-chat.md): Use AgentChat to interact with chat agents from server-side code — tasks, webhooks, scripts, or other agents. (13037 bytes)
- [Sessions](pages/ai-chat/sessions.md): A Session is a stateful execution of an agent, with two-way streaming and durable compute. A single Session can have multiple runs associated with it. (20417 bytes)
- [Side channels](pages/ai-chat/side-channels.md): Named, durable stream pairs on a Session, separate from the chat transcript. A side channel outlives a single run, is shared across runs, and its input does not wake a run. (8647 bytes)
- [chat.local](pages/ai-chat/chat-local.md): Typed, run-scoped data accessible from hooks, run(), tools, and subtasks. Survives across turns, auto-cleared between runs, auto-hydrated into subtasks. (6798 bytes)
- [Types](pages/ai-chat/types.md): TypeScript types for AI Agents, UI messages, and the frontend transport. (9950 bytes)
- [Custom agents](pages/ai-chat/custom-agents.md): Build chat agents without chat.agent()'s managed lifecycle: register with chat.customAgent(), then drive turns with the createSession iterator or a hand-rolled loop. (33993 bytes)
- [How the AI Agents SDK works](pages/ai-chat/how-it-works.md): End-to-end mechanics of a chat.agent turn: the two durable channels per session, the long-lived task that reads and writes them, and how a chat survives refreshes, deploys, and idle gaps. (20773 bytes)
- [Prompts](pages/ai/prompts.md): Define prompt templates as code, version them on deploy, and override from the dashboard without redeploying. (13688 bytes)
- [LLM observability](pages/ai/observability.md): Capture Vercel AI SDK calls in a task as spans in the run trace, with model, token usage, cost, and latency. Opt in per call, link calls to prompt versions, and query usage across runs. (6993 bytes)
- [Fast starts](pages/ai-chat/fast-starts.md): Two ways to cut first-turn TTFC: Preload eagerly triggers the run before the first message; Head Start runs step 1 in your warm server while the agent boots in parallel. (39472 bytes)
- [Compaction](pages/ai-chat/compaction.md): Automatic context compaction to keep long conversations within token limits. (15529 bytes)
- [Prompt caching](pages/ai-chat/prompt-caching.md): Cache the stable prefix of your agent's prompt with Anthropic prompt caching to cut token cost and latency on every turn. (12352 bytes)
- [Pending Messages](pages/ai-chat/pending-messages.md): Inject user messages mid-execution to steer agents between tool-call steps. (15137 bytes)
- [Background injection](pages/ai-chat/background-injection.md): Inject context from background work into the agent's conversation: self-review, RAG augmentation, or any async analysis. (16433 bytes)
- [Actions](pages/ai-chat/actions.md): Custom commands sent from the frontend that mutate chat state without consuming a turn: undo, rollback, edit, regenerate. (7877 bytes)
- [Transcript storage](pages/ai-chat/transcript-storage.md): Where a chat.agent conversation is kept: the UIMessages the runtime saves, the platform default, reading history back, and bringing your own database through the TranscriptStorage adapter. (18480 bytes)
- [Migrate from hydrateMessages to transcript storage](pages/ai-chat/migrating-from-hydrate-messages.md): Move a chat.agent that persists its own history through hydrateMessages onto a TranscriptStorage: map your tables, implement load and save, decide whether you need loadContext, and delete the recovery and compaction cod… (17101 bytes)
- [Error handling](pages/ai-chat/error-handling.md): How errors flow through chat.agent — stream errors, hook errors, run failures — and how to recover. (16635 bytes)
- [Sub-Agents](pages/ai-chat/patterns/sub-agents.md): Delegate work to durable sub-agents from within a parent agent's tool calls, with streaming preliminary results. (15130 bytes)
- [Version upgrades](pages/ai-chat/patterns/version-upgrades.md): Gracefully migrate chat agents to a new deployment using chat.requestUpgrade(), chat.endAndContinue(), and the continuation mechanism. (13278 bytes)
- [Database persistence for chat](pages/ai-chat/patterns/database-persistence.md): Split conversation state and live session metadata across hooks — preload, turn start, turn complete — without tying the pattern to a specific ORM or schema. (20580 bytes)
- [Persistence and replay](pages/ai-chat/patterns/persistence-and-replay.md): How chat.agent rebuilds conversation history at run boot — the transcript storage's persisted conversation plus session.out replay, and what changes when your app owns the model's context. (15518 bytes)
- [Branching conversations](pages/ai-chat/patterns/branching-conversations.md): Build ChatGPT-style conversation trees with edit, regenerate, undo, and branch switching using hydrateMessages, chat.history, and actions. (10764 bytes)
- [Code execution sandbox](pages/ai-chat/patterns/code-sandbox.md): Warm an isolated sandbox on each chat turn, run an AI SDK executeCode tool, and tear down right before the run suspends — using chat.agent hooks and chat.local. (5339 bytes)
- [Human-in-the-loop](pages/ai-chat/patterns/human-in-the-loop.md): Pause the agent mid-response to ask the user a clarifying question, then resume with their answer. (12586 bytes)
- [Tool result auditing](pages/ai-chat/patterns/tool-result-auditing.md): Fire side effects exactly once per resolved tool call — audit logs, billing, notifications — using extractNewToolResults inside hydrateMessages or onTurnComplete. (7313 bytes)
- [Large payloads in chat.agent](pages/ai-chat/patterns/large-payloads.md): Why a single chunk on the chat stream is capped at \1 MiB, what error you'll see, and how to work around it with ID references. (6613 bytes)
- [Agent Skills](pages/ai-chat/patterns/skills.md): Ship reusable capabilities (folders with SKILL.md + scripts) that a chat agent discovers and invokes on demand. (10098 bytes)
- [OOM resilience](pages/ai-chat/patterns/oom-resilience.md): Recover from out-of-memory errors mid-turn by automatically retrying the failed turn on a larger machine — without losing the in-flight user message or re-processing completed turns. (7043 bytes)
- [Recovery boot](pages/ai-chat/patterns/recovery-boot.md): Recover from cancel-mid-stream, crashes, and OOM kills with full conversational context. The smart default Just Works; the onRecoveryBoot hook is the override path for advanced policies. (11689 bytes)
- [Trusted edge signals](pages/ai-chat/patterns/trusted-edge-signals.md): How to safely deliver server-trusted signals (bot scores, JA4, ASN, ReCAPTCHA verdicts) to a chat.agent run via an edge proxy. (15855 bytes)
- [Native compaction & provider fallback](pages/ai-chat/patterns/native-compaction.md): Persist provider-native compaction (Anthropic context editing, OpenAI stored responses) across chat.agent turns so history is never re-sent, and fall back between providers without losing the conversation. (15385 bytes)
- [API Reference](pages/ai-chat/reference.md): Complete API reference for the AI Agents SDK — backend options, events, frontend transport, and hooks. (138326 bytes)
- [Client Protocol](pages/ai-chat/client-protocol.md): The wire protocol for building custom chat transports — how clients communicate with chat agents over Sessions and SSE. (76362 bytes)
- [Testing](pages/ai-chat/testing.md): Drive a chat.agent through real turns in unit tests — no network, no task runtime, no mocking the SDK. (32125 bytes)
- [MCP Server](pages/ai-chat/mcp.md): Chat with your agents from any AI coding tool using the Trigger.dev MCP server. (4246 bytes)
- [Upgrade Guide: prerelease → Sessions-as-run-manager](pages/ai-chat/upgrade-guide.md): Migrating chat.agent code from the prerelease API to the Sessions-as-run-manager release. (23510 bytes)

## Tasks API

- [Trigger](pages/management/tasks/trigger.md): POST /api/v1/tasks/{taskIdentifier}/trigger (3703 bytes)
- [Batch trigger](pages/management/tasks/batch-trigger.md): POST /api/v1/tasks/batch (4086 bytes)
- [Trigger task batch](pages/management/tasks/trigger-batch.md): POST /api/v1/tasks/{taskIdentifier}/batch (4146 bytes)

## Batches API

- [Create batch](pages/management/batches/create.md): POST /api/v3/batches (2309 bytes)
- [Retrieve a batch](pages/management/batches/retrieve.md): GET /api/v1/batches/{batchId} (1853 bytes)
- [Retrieve batch results](pages/management/batches/retrieve-results.md): GET /api/v1/batches/{batchId}/results (1682 bytes)
- [Stream batch items](pages/management/batches/stream-items.md): POST /api/v3/batches/{batchId}/items (2479 bytes)

## Runs API

- [List runs](pages/management/runs/list.md): GET /api/v1/runs (4987 bytes)
- [Retrieve run](pages/management/runs/retrieve.md): GET /api/v3/runs/{runId} (17243 bytes)
- [Replay run](pages/management/runs/replay.md): POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/replay (949 bytes)
- [Cancel run](pages/management/runs/cancel.md): POST /api/v2/runs/{runId}/cancel (1007 bytes)
- [Reschedule run](pages/management/runs/reschedule.md): POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/reschedule (17640 bytes)
- [Update metadata](pages/management/runs/update-metadata.md): PUT /api/v1/runs/{runId}/metadata (1113 bytes)
- [Add tags to a run](pages/management/runs/add-tags.md): POST /api/v1/runs/{runId}/tags (1553 bytes)
- [Retrieve run events](pages/management/runs/retrieve-events.md): GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/events (2630 bytes)
- [Retrieve run trace](pages/management/runs/retrieve-trace.md): GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/trace (3098 bytes)
- [Retrieve run result](pages/management/runs/retrieve-result.md): GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/result (1468 bytes)
